artwork.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE flat, print-ready wraparound artwork reference for a fictional premium 1-litre milk carton. This is a single continuous packaging design, NOT a product photograph. Wide 2048x1024 canvas, four adjoining equal-width vertical rectangular panels, ordered LEFT TO RIGHT: FRONT, RIGHT NUTRITION SIDE, BACK, LEFT STORAGE SIDE. All four panels same ivory paper color with subtle hairline divisions. Do NOT print the panel names or any orientation instructions. All artwork upright, no perspective, no folds, no mockup, no extra margins. Palette warm ivory, deep forest green (#183b30), muted orange sunrise accent (#d87942). Elegant bold readable editorial typography, simple flat illustrated mountains, tactile premium grocery brand. Front panel: large exact uppercase 'SUMMIT' on first line, 'SIGHT' on second, smaller 'WHOLE MILK' beneath. Lower half a large forest-green mountain silhouette with a SMALL orange sun, lower edge '1 L'. Right panel: headline exact 'THE DAILY' then 'DETAILS'. Underneath a restrained ruled nutrition table with exact lines 'Typical values per 100 ml', 'Energy 267 kJ / 64 kcal', 'Fat 3.6 g', 'Carbohydrate 4.7 g', 'Protein 3.4 g'. Small mountain icon at bottom. BACK panel: large exact headline 'A FRESH' then 'PERSPECTIVE.'; a LARGE orange sun disk behind layered forest-green mountains occupies the center, very different from front. Under illustration exact short copy 'Every morning starts with a fresh perspective.' then 'Pour a little possibility into your day.' Small 'SUMMIT SIGHT' at bottom. Left storage panel: exact headline 'KEEP IT' then 'FRESH.'; exact text 'Ingredients: Whole MILK.', 'Keep refrigerated.', 'Once opened, use within 3 days.' A small orange rule, fictional black barcode near bottom, '1 L'. Keep every panel's elements visually distinct and typography legible. Nothing beyond the four panels; no real dairy brand, no certification logos, no watermark. Fictional studio packaging artwork, not real commercial product claims.
